whenToUse: Several videos where one plays at a time: trailers, talks, sessions, a channel's latest uploads, a music video archive.
YouTube or Vimeo videos that must not load third-party content before the visitor presses play.
avoidWhen: A single video — use video-player (VideoPlayer or VideoEmbed).
A grid of many videos that open full screen — use gallery with a lightbox.
a11y: An ordered list of buttons named by the video title; the selected one has aria-current.
Switching announces "Now showing: <title>" politely and keeps focus in the list.
